lesson.what_we_expected: The official program and search guidance would support a bounded internal opportunity package, not a revenue claim.
lesson.what_actually_happened: The package was completed with economics and demand explicitly UNKNOWN and all external steps blocked pending review.
lesson.why_we_think_it_happened: The available sources prove a legitimate route exists but do not prove traffic, conversion, margin, or approval.
lesson.what_changed_in_nexus_knowledge: Revenue can assemble a reviewable opportunity without conflating source existence with verified revenue.
lesson.what_to_do_differently_next_time: Acquire bounded competitor/search-demand and current program-term evidence before requesting an external test.
